patch_description: Replace the per-item Python greedy loops with two fully vectorized heuristics: (1) replication counts computed in one shot via proportional water-filling (`c_i ≈ w_i * num_phy / total`, corrected by rounding to hit the exact total with min 1) instead of `num_redundant` sequential argmax iterations — this both lowers max replica load and drops an O(R) loop; (2) packing via "sorted snake packing": sort weights descending, split into consecutive blocks of `num_packs`, and assign blocks alternately in reverse order (snake) — a classic cardinality-constrained LPT-style heuristic with near-optimal max-load, done entirely in tensor ops (no per-item loop), drastically cutting algorithm execution time while retaining the hierarchical group→node→GPU structure and the exact same inputs/outputs.
